note: What a server sends to tell a client something happened. The sort is named first and settles what follows; unlike WorldEvent it carries no source apart from what the sort itself carries. The header names the unit the event is about.

fields.name: event
fields.note: What happened, and so which shape follows.

fields.name: subject
fields.note: The unit the event is about.

fields.name: kill
fields.note: What comes with a death.

fields.name: gold
fields.note: The gold the death gives.

fields.name: assistCount
fields.note: How many of the places below name a unit that helped.

fields.name: assists
fields.note: Units that helped, twelve places; the rest hold zero.

fields.name: extra
fields.note: A client does not read it.

fields.name: assist
fields.note: What comes with a share in a death.

fields.name: time
fields.note: When it happened.

fields.name: physical
fields.note: Physical damage dealt.

fields.name: magical
fields.note: Magical damage dealt.

fields.name: true
fields.note: True damage dealt.

fields.name: share
fields.note: The share of the death credited.

fields.name: gold
fields.note: The gold it gives.

fields.name: killer
fields.note: The unit credited with the death.

fields.name: event
fields.note: What sort of thing happened, and so which shape follows. Only a turret dying has been observed, and what follows any other sort is not recorded here.

fields.name: credited
fields.note: The unit the death is credited to.

fields.name: gold
fields.note: Gold given for the death. Zero in everything observed.

fields.name: assistCount
fields.note: How many of the places below carry a unit. Zero in everything observed.

fields.name: assists
fields.note: The units that helped, twelve places. Zero in everything observed.
